# MM-P3-L4-HT02 Maintenance manual - Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2

Revision: Rev E  
Plant: P3, line P3-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L4-HT02

Scope
This manual prescribes preventive maintenance, inspection, calibration, and acceptance criteria for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P3-L4-HT02). It applies to maintenance technicians and furnace operators responsible for safe operation, metallurgical control, and traceable records retention. Activities described here are intended to maintain process capability, safety interlocks, and repeatable thermal profiles required by process engineering and quality assurance.

Background and rationale
Maintaining stable austenitizing and cooling profiles in EQ-P3-L4-HT02 is essential to achieve specified microstructure and mechanical properties in forged components. Out-of-tolerance temperatures or degraded thermocouple performance lead to nonconforming parts and potential rework. This manual aligns with change control and operating procedures; see ECN-2026-001 for design changes and SOP-P3-L4-02 and SOP-P3-L4-05 for operation and control-zone responsibilities. Calibration of temperature sensing and verification of setpoints ensure process reproducibility and regulatory traceability.

Critical settings
The austenitizing setpoint for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P3-L4-HT02) is 885 °C.  
The thermocouple calibration interval for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P3-L4-HT02) is 110 days.

Tools and consumables
- Portable data logger capable of NIST-traceable calibration and independent of furnace controller.  
- Spare temperature-sensing elements compatible with furnace input, logged and tagged as calibrated.  
- Non-sparking hand tools for enclosure service, insulated handling gloves, and PPE per site rules.  
- Pre-approved calibration bath or dry-block standard against which thermocouples are compared.  
- Maintenance log forms and electronic records access to document results and corrective actions.

Procedure
Preparation
- Verify lockout-tagout and safety clearance per SOP-P3-L4-05 before any maintenance or calibration work begins.  
- Ensure records from the previous inspection are available for review and that ECN-2026-001 changes are incorporated into wiring and controller settings where applicable.

Visual inspection and housekeeping
- Inspect chamber interior for scale accumulation, damaged insulation, or foreign material that could affect thermal distribution. Remove residues following furnace-specific cleaning procedures detailed in SOP-P3-L4-02, ensuring no abrasive actions expose sensor mounts or thermocouple wells.  
- Check door seals and mechanical interlocks for secure engagement. Any damaged seal or interlock shall be documented and repaired prior to process use.

Thermocouple verification and calibration
- Remove the process thermocouple from the control position and perform a bench comparison to the site standard reference using the calibration bath or dry-block. Record baseline offset for each thermocouple channel.  
- The thermocouple calibration interval for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P3-L4-HT02) is 110 days. Maintain a calibrated tag on each sensor that indicates the last calibration event and links to electronic records. If a sensor shows drift beyond site acceptance (see Acceptance criteria), replace or recondition the sensor and document corrective action.

Controller setpoint confirmation
- With the chamber empty and following warm-up guidance in SOP-P3-L4-02, verify controller reads and maintains the austenitizing setpoint. The austenitizing setpoint for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P3-L4-HT02) is 885 °C. Confirm the controller displays stable indication and that independent data logger confirms the controller output corresponds to actual chamber temperature within acceptance limits.

Sensor redundancy and fail-safes
- Verify redundant sensing channels and alarm thresholds are functioning. Simulate sensor open-circuit and short conditions to confirm alarms and interlocks trip as defined in SOP-P3-L4-05. Document alarm response and any deviations for engineering review.

Mechanical and support systems
- Inspect active cooling connections, circulation ducts, and fans for blockage or degradation that could affect cooling uniformity post-austenitizing. Verify external fixtures and retorts are secure and free from deformation.

Records and documentation
- Complete the maintenance log for EQ-P3-L4-HT02 and attach calibration certificates for any sensors or data loggers used. Include reference to any ECN-2026-001 implementation details and operator procedure changes per SOP-P3-L4-02 and SOP-P3-L4-05. Keep records in the document control system per site policy and ensure traceability from part lots to furnace maintenance events.

Examples of typical entries to keep
- Sensor ID, bench offset, calibration standard used, technician name, and link to calibration certificate.  
- Verification run data from independent data logger showing time-stamped temperature vs. controller setpoint.  
- Description and disposition of any nonconforming reading or replaced component, with reference to ECN-2026-001 when applicable.

Acceptance criteria
- Controller must hold the austenitizing setpoint for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P3-L4-HT02) at 885 °C within the allowable controller control band defined in SOP-P3-L4-02. Independent data logger verification must demonstrate agreement with controller indication under steady-state conditions.  
- Thermocouples used for process control must meet accuracy and stability requirements on their calibration certificate. The thermocouple calibration interval for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P3-L4-HT02) is 110 days; sensors out of interval are not acceptable for process use until calibrated and tagged.  
- Any repaired or replaced sensor, seal, or interlock must be reverified against the acceptance criteria above before the furnace returns to production.

Related documents
- ECN-2026-001  
- SOP-P3-L4-02  
- SOP-P3-L4-05

Revision control
Maintain this document in the document control system. Record each maintenance event under EQ-P3-L4-HT02 entries and reference the applicable SOPs and the ECN where design changes impact maintenance scope.
